*Khao Pad Sapparod* (`Thai Pineapple Fried Rice` ) is a vibrant dish featuring stir-fried jasmine rice with curry powder, savory proteins (like shrimp or chicken), pineapple chunks, and crunchy cashew nuts. It is classically served inside a hollowed-out pineapple shell and offers a delicious balance of sweet, savory, and tangy flavors.[](https://en.ahaan-thai.de/encyclopedia/k/khao-pad-sapparot/) [[1]](https://en.ahaan-thai.de/encyclopedia/k/khao-pad-sapparot/)[[2]](https://tarasmulticulturaltable.com/khao-pad-sapparot-thai-pineapple-fried-rice/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KSGECDNDm0s&t=2)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C84RsN5v3Mv/)

Key Ingredients & Preparation

- **Rice:** Day-old chilled jasmine rice is essential for the best texture so it fries up without getting mushy.
- **Aromatics:** Garlic, shallots, and ginger form the flavorful base.
- **Seasoning:** A blend of curry powder, fish sauce, and a touch of soy sauce gives the dish its signature yellow hue and savory depth.
- **The "Tropical" Element:** Freshly diced pineapple, golden raisins, and roasted cashews provide sweet and crunchy textural contrast.
- **Proteins:** Often made with a mix of shrimp, chicken, or diced Chinese sausage, and scrambled eggs.[](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/) [[1]](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/)[[2]](https://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/pineapple-fried-rice-khao-pad-sapparod-17195113)

For tips on how to prepare the pineapple bowl and get the seasoning and consistency just right:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTPnb_44CToUXKdR8ZNVF4JEeJ8rVhkeZnDFJOw6aPBNdUHt-Db)
9m[Pineapple Fried Rice - Khao Pad Sapparod (ข้าวผัดสัปปะรด) - Thai ...6.5k views  · 7 years ago![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280815-1672-0139-0000-1e2321bef6ad:27)
YouTube · Nin is Cooking](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hgkAksdBTIw&t=15) How to Make It

1. **Prep the Pineapple:** Cut a fresh pineapple in half lengthwise and carefully scoop out the flesh, leaving a 1 2 one-half 1 2 -inch thick border to create your serving bowl. Dice about 1 cup of the pineapple flesh and set aside.[](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/) 
2. **Cook the Aromatics & Protein:** Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Sauté the garlic, followed by your chosen proteins (e.g., shrimp and chicken) until cooked through.[](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/) 
3. **Scramble the Eggs:** Push the meat to one side of the pan, pour in the eggs, and scramble until just set.[](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/) 
4. **Toss the Rice:** Add the cold rice, curry powder, and fish sauce. Stir-fry continuously to break up any clumps and ensure the rice is evenly coated.[](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/) 
5. **Add the Mix-ins:** Stir in the diced pineapple, raisins, cashews, and bell peppers, cooking for just 1–2 minutes to heat through.[](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/) 
6. **Serve:** Garnish with chopped scallions and cilantro, and serve directly in the pineapple shell.[](https://shahzadidevje.com/thai-pineapple-fried-rice-recipe-khao-pad-sapparod/)
